subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should OpenClaw ship this opt-in `agents.*.iterationBudget` contract with the current keys, defaults, pre-tool-round hook semantics, and fail-closed unsupported-harness behavior?
rationale: The implementation appears technically sound, but the PR creates user-visible config and harness/API behavior that becomes a compatibility contract after release.

options.title: Confirm Contract And Refresh
options.body: Approve the current names/defaults/semantics, refresh the branch against current main, and merge once checks remain green.

options.title: Rename Or Narrow First
options.body: Change any config keys, defaults, hook behavior, or unsupported-harness semantics before release so compatibility does not need to be carried later.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Issue
options.body: Keep the design discussion in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9912 if maintainers are not ready to bless a hard iteration-budget contract.
